subject: general
question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are taking part in a race, each with a car of different colour, i.e. black, white, blue, yellow, red, not necessarily in same order. Blue car is leading in the race and A is the slowest person in the race. The one that has red car is just behind E. B has a white car and it needs to cross just one person to be at the second position. C is just behind D. The one who is at the second last position does not drive black car. Who is driving yellow car and what is its position in the race?
solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are taking part in a race, each with a car of different colour, i.e. black, white, blue, yellow, red.

1) Blue car is leading in the race and A is the slowest person in the race.

Blue car > _ > _ > _ > A

2) The one that has red car is just behind E.

E > Red car

3) B has a white car and it needs to cross just one person to be at the second position.&l
